description: Batch of landed changes waiting for the next full CI run. Append with `python3 tools/ci_pending.py add ...`; tools/ci.sh archives this file to runs/ci/<run-id>/pending.json and resets it at the start of every run. See docs/CI-WORKFLOW.md.

policy.full_gate: tools/run-cpu-intensive-task.sh --ci, owned by the CI fixer; do not run the full gate after every edit
policy.record: one entry per landed change/batch: files, likely gates, reproduction command and expected result
policy.wipe: archived and reset by tools/ci.sh at run start
